info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizdoc-List Support Tickets Status-v4-spec
info.description: The Support Ticket Status Retrieval API enables users to access the current statuses of support tickets within the system. This endpoint provides critical visibility for clients and support teams to track ticket progress, ensuring timely updates and efficient resolution management. Typical consumers include customer service representatives, support agents, and end-users seeking information on their submitted tickets. By utilizing this API, organizations can enhance their support processes and improve customer satisfaction.

get.summary: Retrieve the current status of tickets.
get.description: This endpoint allows developers to fetch the latest status of tickets in the system, providing updates on their progress and any relevant information needed for further actions.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving the status of tickets. This request requires a JSON body that includes necessary parameters to obtain the current status information.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the current status of tickets.
